cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import cli, pyref
from test_mutate import load_verdict, py_verdict
binary=cli.build()
rng=random.Random(2024)
# 4096 distinct front64 keys, 2 prefixes each (8192 prefixes)
d={}
for i in range(4096):
    key=(0x2001000000000000 | i)
    for j,ln in ((0,128),(1,66)):
        hi=key; lo=rng.getrandbits(64) if j==0 else 0
        hi,lo=pyref.norm(hi,lo,ln); d[(hi,lo,ln)]=rng.randint(0,4194302)
print('prefixes',len(d),'keys',len(set(k[0] for k in d if k[2]>64)))
ops=[['put','%016x%016x'%(k[0],k[1]),k[2],v] for k,v in d.items()]+[['save'],['load_saved',0]]
t=time.time(); res=cli.results({'cases':[{'ops':ops}]},binary)[0]; print('capture %.2fs'%(time.time()-t))
snap=res['snapshots'][0]
print('fronts',len(snap['front64']),'rows',sum(len(b) for b in snap['banks']),'bytes',len(json.dumps(snap)),'loads',res['loads'])
t=time.time(); got=pyref.validate(snap); print('pyref %.2fs ok=%s same=%s'%(time.time()-t,len(got),got=={(k[0],k[1],k[2]):v for k,v in d.items()}))
# also load the python-built variant with 4096 fronts
img=pyref.build_image(sorted([(k[0],k[1],k[2],v) for k,v in d.items()]),rng)
t=time.time(); print('cpp load pyimage',load_verdict(binary,img),'%.2fs'%(time.time()-t))
# 4096 front16 keys
d2={}
for i in range(4096):
    hi=(i<<48)|rng.getrandbits(48)
    for ln in (33,50):
        h,l=pyref.norm(hi,0,ln); d2[(h,l,ln)]=rng.randint(0,4194302)
print('front16 prefixes',len(d2))
ops=[['put','%016x%016x'%(k[0],k[1]),k[2],v] for k,v in d2.items()]+[['save'],['load_saved',0]]
res=cli.results({'cases':[{'ops':ops}]},binary)[0]
snap=res['snapshots'][0]
print('front16 list',len(snap['front16']),'rows',sum(len(b) for b in snap['banks']),'loads',res['loads'],'py',py_verdict(snap) is False or True)
got=pyref.validate(snap); print('same', got=={(k[0],k[1],k[2]):v for k,v in d2.items()})
